messages:
anya: Heads-up: Cobalt Accelerator EAP onboarding kicked off. Partner team sent NDA + lab access tonight. Need ops/bench/legal/pe to align on benchmarks, telemetry, and handback plan. Timeline: EAP start Mon Apr 6 (T+7). Who can own lab access & perf runs?

thomas: I can own infra access (VPN creds, jumpbox). Need IP ranges and ssh key format. @raul do partners expose a bastion or will we use their lab VPN?

raul: They gave two options: shared bastion with certs or per-user VPN. Prefer per-user VPN for audit. I'll follow up with their lab ops for cert workflow.

jess: Bench team here — need model artifacts, sample workloads, and target SLOs. Suggest we run: 
```bash
./run_perf.sh --model cobalt-v1 --bs 1 --seq 2048 --profile
```
Also want telemetry hooks (latency hist, token breakdown).

olivia: Legal has NDA draft. Quick note: redwood must be allowed to publish anonymized perf numbers after embargo. I'll attach redline in drive. Also need to confirm data handling for telemetry (PII concerns).

anya: Great. Action items: @thomas infra setup by Wed, @jess bench plan by Thu, @olivia confirm NDA + embargo clause, @raul confirm bastion option. Also: coordinate marketplace onboarding checklist (pub date decoupled from EAP).

partners-bot: Partner (Cobalt Systems) confirmed on-call window 9am-5pm PST for runs Day 1.

jess: For bench config, prefer quantized and fp16 variants; we'll run 3 repeats and capture p95/p99. Can we get NVLINK topology info? Also request a small golden input set (100 prompts).

thomas: NVLINK / topology might be redacted. We'll at least grab PCI ids + device names. I'll open ticket to hardware team. Also provisioning note: need service account for Telemetry ingest with write-only role.

olivia: On telemetry: require explicit consent in NDA for exporting perf logs out of partner lab. If not, we'll need to anonymize on-prem and only send aggregates.

anya: Noted. Let's schedule a kickoff call tomorrow 10am PT. I'll send invite. Calendar invite created by calendar-bot.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: 'Cobalt EAP Kickoff' Tue Apr 7 10:00 PT — invite sent to participants.

thomas: Quick ops note: add firewall rule templated as below to avoid failures: 
```yaml
- name: allow-cobalt-jumpbox
  src_ranges: ["203.0.113.0/24"]
  ports: [22, 443]
```
I'll put in PR.

jess: +1. After first run we'll post a short summary in #bench-results and share slide with partner. plan to run smoke tests tonight on staging.

raul: Partner asked for a short joint statement embargo window 2 weeks after final validation. Keep comms tight.

anya: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a checklist doc — will post link here once created. :rocket:
